scope.capture: At already-observed actual ATTDEF source callback, not later handle-only lookup
scope.immutableDescriptor: Generation, process-local BLOCK scope, dispatch, source/typed events, physical record/span and per-block membership index
scope.immutableOwners: Exact model/raw/children/delivery and original/effective/footer/beginRaw/endRaw shared owners; identical-value replacement is insufficient
scope.sourceBound: Original single physical ATTDEF record and adjacent source/typed event roles, identities, spans and frozen owners agree
scope.pairBound: Actual expected typed callback observed; frozen source/model fields agree
scope.enclosingMatched: Complete endpoint/ATTDEF source profiles, reconciled BLOCK_RECORD, complete observed replay and matching original owner
scope.query: Revalidate tuple plus closed successful first-generation actual DXF import and retention flags; preliminary enclosing state cannot certify whole-source failure
scope.advisoryBinding: TABLECONTENT selected ATTDEF lookup now requires the resulting origin/enclosing fact; not full semantic/output proof
scope.index: Per-block handles avoid scanning every resource per block
scope.charging: Before descriptor allocation and indexed visits; descriptor/control owner plus conservative index reallocation allowance
scope.chargeLimit: Logical allowances, not whole-process RSS, every allocator, allocator capacity or a CPU theorem
scope.failure: Own evidence quota/allocation fails closed without changing ordinary format admission; inherited shared-reader limits remain separate
scope.drawings: Only locally authored runtime scratch controls

owningControlsPerConfiguration.axes: AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 x ASCII LF/CRLF/Binary x classic/two embedded ATTDEF forms
owningControlsPerConfiguration.independentLimit: Local independent original-file scalar/span walker, not independent external semantic or kernel qualification
owningControlsPerConfiguration.allocationLimit: Observed new descriptor/control and per-block vector allocation sites only; synthetic recapture uses real imported snapshots but its context is deliberately unqualified; weak owners expire after teardown; not every allocator or leak-detector evidence
owningControlsPerConfiguration.mixedLimit: Both immutable resource queries refuse reordered index and recover after restoration; not POLYLINE/INSERT compound semantics
owningControlsPerConfiguration.laterFailureLimit: Historical EnclosingMatched remains inspectable but cannot pass successful-import query; expected read errors are intentional

integration.diagnosticChange: Existing malformed ATTDEF owner now fails earlier original/enclosing proof as ResourceProofMissing, rather than later WrongOwner; fault and recovery assertions retained

intermediateOverbroadSelector.response: Build missing target in both configurations; exact final affected shortlist includes it and passes 33/33 each
intermediateOverbroadSelector.limit: Intermediate broad selection is not claimed as a green full-source cohort; ancillary tests outside the rebuilt shortlist are not final-source evidence

validation.compatibilityLimit: Local mirrored source/API compilation and CLI checks, not native LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD execution or formal binary ABI certification
